rows.about:
Northline is a small outdoor-gear shop in Portland, Oregon. We sell shells, packs, boots and camp kit that we use ourselves on wet trails.

Everything ships from our shop on NW Kearney Street. We answer every e-mail ourselves.
rows.privacy:
We keep what we need to send your order: your name, e-mail and address. We never sell it and we never share it with other customers.

News e-mails go only to people who ticked the box. Every news e-mail has a link to stop them.

You can delete your details from your account at any time. Orders you placed stay on the shop's records.
rows.terms:
Prices are in US dollars. Shipping and tax are added at checkout; tax depends on the state you ship to.

We ship to US addresses only. You can send things back within 30 days after we ship.

Gift cards can be used for anything in the shop. They can't be exchanged for money.
